from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper regarding its title and references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other *provided* papers in the collection that are cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
